explanation: II has coprime moduli 3 and 16, whose product is 48, so the Chinese remainder theorem gives a unique solution modulo 48 (x≡14). I has no solution because its congruences require opposite parities. III reduces to x≡7 modulo 12, giving four classes modulo 48: 7, 19, 31, and 43. This tests number theory outside the supplied course topics, so it is prerequisite.
